findings.explanation: WLC-023 allows window movement for 60 s after ignition off, while this requirement says 45 s (or until a front door opens). Both cannot be met.
findings.rewrite: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for [TBD: confirm 45 s or 60 s] or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first. (Delete WLC-023.)

findings.explanation: "Quickly" is not measurable. It is also unclear whether it means the normal travel time or a faster one, and whether anti-pinch stays active.
findings.rewrite: When the rain sensor reports rain, the controller shall close the window to fully closed within [TBD: time limit] of the rain report, with anti-pinch protection active.

findings.quote: Anti-pinch protection shall be active in manual mode and in express mode.
findings.explanation: Manual mode is possible when the controller is not normalized, but WLC-017 disables anti-pinch in that state. The two contradict each other.
findings.rewrite: When the controller is normalized, anti-pinch protection shall be active in manual mode and in express mode.

findings.quote: Anti-pinch protection shall be disabled when the controller is not normalized.
findings.explanation: This contradicts WLC-016, which requires anti-pinch in manual mode with no normalization condition. Manual closing is allowed when not normalized.
findings.rewrite: When the controller is not normalized, anti-pinch protection shall be [TBD: disabled or active with limits] in manual mode. (Align with WLC-016.)

findings.explanation: "Robust" and "all disturbances" cannot be tested. No test can cover every disturbance, and no pass criterion is given.
findings.rewrite: The anti-pinch function shall not trigger a false pinch detection when [TBD: list of disturbances, e.g. road shock profile, voltage range] is applied, and shall still detect a pinch above 100 N.

findings.explanation: WLC-007 gives 45 s (plus door-open cutoff) for the same situation. Both cannot be met.
findings.rewrite: Delete this requirement and keep one timer value in WLC-007: [TBD: confirm 45 s or 60 s].

findings.explanation: The temperature limit is not given, and "a safe value" for the reduced current is also not given. Neither can be tested.
findings.rewrite: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds [TBD: temperature limit], the controller shall reduce motor current to no more than [TBD: reduced current limit in A].

findings.quote: shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A01 when the Hall sensor signal is missing for more than 200 ms while the motor is driven, and shall stop the motor
findings.explanation: It combines storing a DTC and stopping the motor, which need separate tests. The stop has no time limit.
findings.rewrite: WLC-029a: The controller shall store DTC B1A01 when the Hall sensor signal is missing for more than 200 ms while the motor is driven. WLC-029b: In that case the controller shall stop the motor within [TBD: stop time].

findings.quote: shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status
findings.explanation: It has three separate behaviours (store DTC, stop motor, set fault state in CAN) joined by three "shall"s. The stop has no time limit.
findings.rewrite: WLC-030a: The controller shall store DTC B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms. WLC-030b: In that case the controller shall stop the motor within [TBD: stop time]. WLC-030c: In that case the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

findings.quote: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
findings.explanation: It repeats WLC-004 word for word.
"User friendly" is subjective and not measurable.
findings.rewrite: [TBD: measurable usability criteria, e.g. a standard or test with pass criteria].

findings.quote: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.
findings.explanation: This is about how the software is developed, not what the product does. It also does not name which process.
findings.rewrite: Move to a project or quality plan. If a product requirement is needed, name it, e.g. [TBD: required standard or software integrity level].
